claims.text: Assuming the accepted graded basis \(Q=\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z\,e_\rho\), with \(\deg e_\rho=ij+|\rho|\), one has \[ H_Q(z)=z^{ij}\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}z^{|\rho|} =z^{ij}\binom{a+b}{a}_z. \]
The formula \[ \rho^\vee=(b-\rho_a,\ldots,b-\rho_1) \] is an involution on partitions in \(b^a\) and satisfies \[ |\rho^\vee|=ab-|\rho|. \]
The integral bilinear form \[ \langle e_\rho,e_\sigma\rangle=\delta_{\sigma,\rho^\vee} \] is a perfect degree-complement pairing \[ Q_d\times Q_{\,2ij+ab-d}\longrightarrow\mathbb Z. \]
